ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening covers all directors, shareholders, beneficial owners, authorized signatories, project financing counterparties, EPC subcontractors, and municipal concession counterparties against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, European Union consolidated financial sanctions list, UK OFSI consolidated list, China's terrorist organization list, and the World Bank Group sanctions list. PEP status is established through commercial KYC databases, court and adverse media searches, and signed disclosure questionnaires. Any PEP or sanctioned person triggers senior management approval, enhanced due diligence, additional source-of-funds verification, and 90-day periodic rescreening before each World Bank escrow disbursement and SWIFT wire.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: SAMR National Enterprise Name Self-Declaration System of the State Administration for Market Regulation, administered locally through provincial municipal Market Supervision Administration online platforms
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The WFOE Chinese name must be written in standard simplified Chinese characters and must follow the four-tier statutory formula: administrative division plus trade name plus industry characteristics plus organizational form. The foreign parent name must be phonetically transliterated or translated into Chinese; an English name may be registered only as a translation and cannot replace the Chinese name. The industry descriptor must accurately reflect the approved ISIC 4220 water treatment and sewage engineering scope, and the legal form must be limited liability.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant should first read the rejection reasons in the SAMR name clearance portal and either correct the trade name, industry descriptor, or transliteration and file a new reservation or pursue an administrative appeal. Administrative reconsideration must be filed with the next higher market regulation authority within 60 days of the notice; an administrative lawsuit may be filed with the people's court within 6 months. A name reservation cannot be extended after the 30-day term; the applicant must resubmit a fresh application. The appeal must include the proposed four-tier Chinese name, its English transliteration, the ISIC 4220 industry scope, and evidence of non-infringement of prior registered names.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or commercial mailbox is not permissible for this WFOE. SAMR, the tax bureau, and banks uniformly reject a virtual address for business license registration and account opening in the water treatment EPC sector. The registered address must be a physical, rentable, and accessible office or operational site in mainland China; a mere mail forwarding address will cause refusal of VAT general taxpayer registration, invoice issuance, banking settlement, and sectoral water-treatment qualification approval.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist for unannounced inspection: (1) original lease contract registered with the local housing authority; (2) landlord certificate of property ownership; (3) paid rent invoices with tax withholding records; (4) visible signage matching the approved Chinese company name; (5) utility bills for electricity, water, and internet in the company name; (6) staff presence during normal business hours; (7) on-site project records for reverse osmosis sewage treatment design and commissioning. Quantified risk: high, approximately 65 percent probability of an unannounced on-site inspection by municipal market supervision or tax authorities within the first 12 months, increased by the government-funded municipal sewage project context and World Bank escrow obligations.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision, effective 1 July 2024), Articles 5, 23, 24, 28, 32, 35, 41, 46, 47, 49, 51, 58, 62 and 82; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2019), Article 12; Regulations on Implementing the Foreign Investment Law; Regulation of the People's Republic of China on the Administration of Market Entities Registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) -- Enterprise Registration Bureau, acting through the authorized Municipal Administration for Market Regulation enterprise registration window or the integrated online government service portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Establishment Registration of a Foreign-Invested Market Entity, accompanied by the Articles of Association and the Shareholder Resolution of CN WFOE LTD.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to a general wholly foreign-owned enterprise. The registered capital is a subscribed amount stated in the Articles of Association and must be paid by each shareholder within five years from the date of incorporation unless the Articles or the applicable regime impose a shorter period. No blocked escrow account is required under Chinese law for the capital contribution account; the sole shareholder must transfer contributions from an overseas account to the company's designated capital contribution settlement account at a licensed bank, and the bank will file the receipt with the State Administration of Foreign Exchange under the foreign direct investment (FDI) system. EPC contract advances and performance security may be held in escrow only if the commercial contract so provides.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF CN WFOE LTD (THE COMPANY), ADOPTED ON [DATE] BY THE FIRST MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS. The directors acknowledge that a quorum was present and that this resolution is made in accordance with the Company Law of the People's Republic of China and the Articles of Association. 1. Share Capital Subscription and Payment. The board ratifies the subscription of the entire registered capital of the Company by the sole shareholder and approves the capital contribution schedule. The board confirms that no statutory minimum paid-up capital or blocked escrow account is required for the Company, and instructs the general manager to open a designated capital contribution account with a licensed bank, to receive contributions in freely convertible foreign currency, and to ensure that all contributions are paid within the period stipulated by law and the Articles. 2. Banking and Payment Authorizations. The board designates the principal relationship bank and authorizes the legal representative and the general manager, acting jointly for any wire transfer above USD 50,000 and individually for operational payments below that threshold, to open bank accounts, execute account documents, apply for electronic banking tokens, and complete foreign exchange registration. The board specifically approves the use of SWIFT wires and World Bank escrow arrangements as payment rails for the municipal sewage treatment EPC contract. 3. Adoption of Registered Office. The board adopts the premises at [REGISTERED OFFICE ADDRESS] as the registered office and statutory mailing address of the Company in China, and directs the legal representative to file the address, submit the lease and ownership documents, and maintain the office as the seat of management. 4. Appointment of Statutory Officers. The board appoints [NAME] as legal representative, [NAME] as general manager, [NAME] as supervisor, and [NAME] as chief financial officer. The supervisor shall not serve concurrently as a director or as general manager. The board adopts an authorized signatory matrix requiring dual approval for contracts, guarantees, and banking instruments above USD 50,000. 5. Corporate Governance and Compliance. The board directs the general manager to establish accounting records, internal controls, and a seal management system; to register the Company for tax, social insurance, and foreign exchange purposes; and to obtain all environmental, civil defense, and industrial licenses required for the design, construction, and commissioning of the reverse osmosis water treatment and municipal sewage treatment plant. This resolution is effective immediately and may be executed by unanimous written consent in lieu of a further meeting.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Business Scope Pre-Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) National Enterprise Name Reservation System through the Municipal Administration for Market Regulation online service window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application through the municipal SAMR online service portal or at the government service center. Select limited liability company with foreign investment, enter the proposed English and transliterated Chinese name, and set the registered capital, shareholder identification, proposed business scope, and legal representative information. The proposed business scope must include design, construction, commissioning and operation of water treatment systems to match ISIC 4220 and the negative-list review. The system will issue a name pre-approval notice; if the name contains prohibited terms, modify and resubmit. A foreign shareholder's identity documents must be notarized and apostilled or legalized by PRC consular authorities.
required_dossiers: Proposed name and name-meaning statement
Passport or identity proof of the foreign shareholder (notarized and consular legalized)
Power of attorney to the local formation agent
Proposed business scope and registered capital table
Consent to use the registered address from the landlord
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name reservation is rejected, review the SAMR rejection reasons, adjust the name by adding a distinguishable geographic element or corporate identifier, and resubmit. A refusal based on prohibited words may be cured by deleting those words. If the rejection is allegedly erroneous, submit a written complaint to the municipal SAMR and, if necessary, apply for administrative reconsideration within 60 days of the refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Formal Establishment Application and Issuance of Business License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) integrated online government service portal or the market entity registration hall
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After name pre-approval, submit the formal establishment application on the integrated online government service portal or in person at the municipal SAMR. Execute the Articles of Association, the shareholder resolution, and the application forms in the presence of the licensed formation agent or using the SAMR face-recognition system. Attach the lease contract, landlord's property ownership certificate, and a letter of commitment confirming the office is used as the statutory registered address. SAMR will conduct a legality review, verify that the foreign shareholder is eligible under the prudential negative list, and issue the business license with the unified social credit code. The legal representative must sign the application and produce the original passport.
required_dossiers: Name Pre-Approval Notice
Signed Articles of Association
Shareholder resolution approving the Articles and capital subscription
Business premises lease contract and property ownership certificate
Identity documents of legal representative, directors, and supervisor
Foreign Investment information filing form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the establishment application is queried or suspended, respond to the SAMR notice within the statutory period with revised Articles or rectified ownership proofs. If the application is denied, the shareholder may file administrative reconsideration with the municipal government or a higher SAMR within 60 days, or file a new application after curing the stated defects.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Seal Engraving and Public Security Bureau Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau (PSB) licensed seal engraving enterprise and the local PSB seal record filing office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After obtaining the business license, engage an authorized seal engraving enterprise approved by the Public Security Bureau and request engraving of the company seal, financial seal, contract seal, invoice seal and legal representative seal. The engraving enterprise must record the seal impressions and anti-counterfeit code in the PSB seal filing system within the statutory time limit. Each seal must be stored in the custody of the general manager or the designated administrative officer. Maintain a seal usage log requiring dual signatures for contracts, bank instruments, and license applications. The legal representative shall issue a written authorization specifying the purpose of each seal and the authority of the custodian.
required_dossiers: Original business license and unified social credit code
Legal representative passport and instruction letter
Company seal engraving application form (PSB-prescribed)
Seal custody and usage authorization matrix
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If seal engraving or filing is delayed, contact the licensed engraving enterprise to obtain a written progress certificate and file a complaint with the PSB. If a seal is refused, verify the legal representative identity certificate and authorization letter and re-register after correction. A lost seal requires a public notice in an official newspaper before a replacement seal can be engraved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account Opening and Foreign Direct Investment Foreign Exchange Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Designated commercial bank acting as agent for the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE); SAFE local branch for verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a basic RMB deposit account and a foreign currency capital account at a licensed commercial bank. The bank acts as the receiving institution for the SAFE foreign direct investment filing: submit the business license, the SAMR establishment information, the Articles of Association, the legal representative passport, the beneficial ownership declaration, and the overseas remittance instruction. The bank will verify the identity of the ultimate beneficial owner, perform anti-money laundering screening, and submit the foreign exchange registration through the SAFE digital system. Once approved, the bank issues the foreign investment registration code and enables SWIFT wire receipts and World Bank escrow payments. Foreign exchange receipts must be used consistently with the business scope.
required_dossiers: Business license and unified social credit code
Articles of Association
SAMR foreign-investment establishment filing confirmation
Passports of legal representative and beneficial owner
Board resolution on bank signatory authority
SWIFT remittance instructions or capital contribution letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries or withholds the FDI registration, provide enhanced due diligence documents, complete the beneficial ownership statement, and resubmit to the bank compliance unit. If SAFE returns the filing, correct the registration data through the bank within 10 working days. If the capital account is suspended, issue a written explanation and cure any title or purpose mismatch before refiling.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, Social Insurance, and Employment Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Taxation Administration municipal tax service hall; Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau; Municipal Housing Fund Management Center
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete tax, social insurance, and employment registration at the municipal tax service hall or online. The SAMR establishment data is shared with the State Taxation Administration, but the company must still apply for tax registration, financial institution banking linkage, invoice quota and electronic invoice issuance. Determine whether to register as a value-added tax general taxpayer based on annual revenue and procurement needs. Register employees with the social insurance bureau and housing fund administration within thirty days of hiring. The legal representative should also complete risk control filings for the low-risk AML classification as required by the designated bank and sign the payroll authorization mandate. Keep all registration receipts in the corporate compliance binder.
required_dossiers: Business license and unified social credit code
Legal representative identity document
Lease contract and utility bill for tax address
Board resolution appointing tax contact and financial officer
Employee roster and labor contracts
Bank deposit account opening certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax registration is not synchronized, go to the tax hall to complete a one-to-one correction. A late-registration penalty may be mitigated by submitting a no-fault explanation and an application for administrative grace. For social insurance or housing fund complaints, rectify the payroll records and submit the correct enrollment list to restore compliance before any inspection deadline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment Project Filing, Environmental Approval, and Construction Licensing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal Development and Reform Commission; Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau; Municipal Housing and Urban-Rural Development Bureau; Municipal Emergency Management Bureau
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before commencing construction on the sewage treatment plant, complete the foreign investment and fixed asset investment filing at the Municipal Development and Reform Commission and verify that the business is not on the negative list. Then apply to the Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau for environmental impact assessment approval, to the Municipal Housing and Urban-Rural Development Bureau for construction permits, water intake and drainage permits, and to the Municipal Emergency Management Bureau for civil defense fire design review. If the plant will operate after commissioning, apply for the Pollutant Discharge Permit and a municipal sewage treatment operation license. These filings are not part of the SAMR registration but are mandatory preconditions to physical construction and operation.
required_dossiers: Business license and unified social credit code
Foreign investment project filing form
Environmental impact assessment report and public participation records
Land use right certificate or site lease
Construction drawings and structural design certification
Fire protection design review application and compliance statement
Water intake and drainage connection approval applications
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the investment filing or EIA application is rejected, cure the project description, revise the site selection data, supplement the EIA baseline and resubmit. If the fire design review identifies violations, amend the design and obtain a new review opinion before proceeding with construction. A permit refusal may be challenged by administrative reconsideration within the statutory period or judicial review in the People's Court.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Municipal Housing and Urban-Rural Development Bureau (MOHURD), Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau, Municipal Emergency Management Bureau, and the Civil Defense/Fire and Rescue Department
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Pollutant Discharge Permit and Urban Drainage and Sewage Treatment Operation Permit for the municipal sewage treatment plant

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment (MEE) and the delegated Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Full Environmental Impact Assessment Report (Category A) requiring approval before construction; the project is classified as a high-environmental-risk public infrastructure project with mandatory public participation, baseline water quality monitoring, and post-project monitoring plan.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Treated effluent must meet GB 18918-2002 Class 1A thresholds: COD not exceeding 50 mg/L, BOD5 not exceeding 10 mg/L, SS not exceeding 10 mg/L, NH3-N not exceeding 5 mg/L (or 8 mg/L at water temperature below 12 degrees Celsius), total nitrogen not exceeding 15 mg/L, total phosphorus not exceeding 0.5 mg/L, and total coliforms not exceeding 1000 MPN/L. Air emission and odor control must comply with GB 14554-93 and GB 16297-1996, with non-methane total hydrocarbons limited to 120 mg/m3 for relevant VOC sources. Sludge must be treated to meet the stabilization requirements of GB 18918 and transported under an electronic manifest to licensed disposers. Hazardous waste must be stored for no more than 90 days in a permitted facility and transferred only to licensed treatment entities with hazardous waste transfer manifests.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire protection design review and final acceptance certificate must be obtained from the Fire and Rescue Department before commissioning; regular fire safety inspections and annual testing of fire suppression systems are mandatory. Civil defense approval is required for any underground structures, effluent basins, and confined spaces under the Civil Defense law. Structural load inspections and building completion acceptance are required for all tanks and process buildings. Occupational safety clearance includes an occupational disease hazard assessment under the Occupational Disease Prevention Law, confined-space entry permits, registration of pressure vessels, gas detectors, and hazardous process safety management for any sludge digestion or chemical storage areas.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China, administered locally through the competent tax service bureaus; online filing and registration through the National Electronic Tax Bureau (e-Tax Bureau) portal
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a WFOE, incorporate with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR); the 18-digit Unified Social Credit Code (USCC) on the business license is automatically the PRC tax identification number (TIN/VAT ID). Complete all required post-incorporation tax registration steps with the local STA office within 30 days through the e-Tax Bureau: verify entity legal status as a resident enterprise, assign legal representative, finance officer, accounting system basis, bank deposit account information, and VAT taxpayer status. Because tax registration is integrated with SAMR under the one-license-one-code system, no separate TIN certificate is issued; the USCC is used for all VAT, EIT, payroll and withholding filings. A foreign investor that is itself a non-resident enterprise with China-source income but no permanent establishment must separately register for a non-resident enterprise tax identification number on the e-Tax Bureau before its Chinese withholding obligations can be performed.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None for entity classification: the PRC Enterprise Income Tax Law does not provide check-the-box or US-style pass-through elections; a WFOE is mandatorily a resident enterprise taxed at entity level. No hybrid mismatch election is available. For VAT, an eligible small-scale taxpayer may elect general VAT taxpayer status where annual taxable turnover is below the statutory threshold and the relevant STA conditions are satisfied.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Basic tax registration is mandatory as soon as the WFOE receives its business license, regardless of turnover. For general VAT taxpayer classification, the mandatory economic threshold is annual taxable sales exceeding RMB 5,000,000; turnover below this level results in small-scale taxpayer status unless the taxpayer elects general taxpayer status.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The STA mandates electronic invoice issuance through the Fully Digitalized Electronic Invoice system on the National Electronic Tax Bureau; invoice data is transmitted in real time to the Golden Tax Phase IV system. VAT special invoices require tax-control clearance and carry an STA-assigned anti-fraud invoice code and digital tax-control stamp before lawful issuance. High-volume taxpayers must integrate their billing software with the e-Tax Bureau by approved API to obtain invoice authorisation and clear issued invoices before monthly VAT returns are filed.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rated VAT applies to goods physically exported from and simultaneously delivered out of the PRC customs territory where the exporter is a general VAT taxpayer, files a Customs Export Goods Declaration, receives consideration in foreign exchange from the overseas buyer, and completes export tax refund (exemption) procedures. Qualifying cross-border services, including design and commissioning services for water treatment works where the services are wholly consumed outside mainland China and paid in foreign exchange, are also zero-rated where they fall within the cross-border tax services zero-rated catalogue. Domestic construction, installation and commissioning performed inside China are not zero-rated and are taxable at the applicable 9% or 6% rates.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Goods Declaration (customs declaration form for exported goods)
Original Bill of Lading or equivalent multimodal transport document evidencing export movement
Foreign exchange receipt confirmation / export collection verification record from the receiving bank (inward remittance evidence)
Export sales contract and commercial invoice
VAT invoice for export sales issued under the electronic tax invoice system
Technical acceptance or commissioning certificate evidencing offshore delivery of services, where applicable
Certificate of origin (where required for customs preference or transit)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: If zero-rating is claimed without full export movement, foreign-currency receipt and statutory documentation, the STA rejects the claim, claws back any VAT refunded, charges daily late-payment surcharge (0.05% per day) from the date of refund, and imposes a penalty under the PRC Tax Administration Law of between 50% and 500% of the tax involved for evasion or fraudulent refund claims. Criminal exposure under the PRC Criminal Law for export tax fraud may result in imprisonment and fines. A retrospective audit is not time-barred in cases of fraud; otherwise the general audit recovery period is three years, extendable to five years for understatement by tax planning, and refunds may be clawed back accordingly.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The People's Bank of China (PBOC) through the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: On the current account, China has historically achieved de facto convertibility: business operating income from cross-border trade and services can be converted into RMB at market rates through licensed banks, subject to truthfulness and documentation review. The capital account remains formally controlled: equity injections into a WFOE require SAFE foreign investment registration and are drawn through a capital account, while cross-border loans, derivatives and portfolio flows require specific quotas or approvals. There is no mandatory surrender of export proceeds in the post-2012 regime, so a WFOE may retain earned foreign currency and settle the amount when commercially prudent. Profit remittance by a WFOE is permitted after payment of corporate income tax and completion of an annual statutory audit; the bank performs a tax clearance check, and dividends must be sourced from after-tax retained earnings. The principal remaining hurdle is administrative documentation: banks require contracts, invoices, customs records, and tax certificates to validate each remittance, and capital account proceeds cannot be used outside the permitted business scope.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory mandatory conversion ratio. Under SAFE administration, export proceeds may be retained in foreign currency; the repatriation and verification cycle is normally 180 days from export customs declaration. For advance export receipts, the WFOE must ensure the receiving bank completes declaration in the Goods Trade Monitoring System; failure to repatriate within the trade-cycle window triggers SAFE compliance review. No mandatory sale to the bank is imposed, and the conversion decision belongs to the enterprise.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Basic Operating Foreign Currency Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Account and RMB Basic Deposit Account
Basic Operational Currency Account and Foreign Exchange Settlement Account
Basic Deposit Account and Capital Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Not viable and not permitted for a mainland WFOE. In China, only licensed banks are empowered by PBOC and CBIRC to hold current and capital account deposits, conduct foreign exchange settlement, and access the RMB and FX clearing systems. Non-bank fintech EMIs and offshore digital banks cannot issue onshore account numbers or process local RMB clearing for a foreign-invested entity; overseas EMIs can only offer movement on correspondent banking and would not satisfy SAFE capital verification or profit remittance documentation. A WFOE must maintain its primary treasury channel through a domestic tier-1 commercial bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The legal representative of the WFOE is normally required to appear in person at a licensed bank branch to complete corporate account opening, show original passport, business license and company seal, and attend the KYC interview. A remotely notarized consular power of attorney can, in certain banks, allow an authorized individual to attend, but the bank will still require the ultimate beneficial owners to complete identity verification and may call for a video or face-to-face interview. Pure remote online onboarding for a newly incorporated foreign-invested WFOE is exceptional and limited to pilot fintech zones; physical presence remains the prudent norm.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO chain opacity through an offshore intermediate company and nominee director or nominee shareholder filings.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A complete beneficial ownership chart upward to natural persons; certified share register and articles of association at each layer; UBO self-declaration; CRS tax self-certification for each controlling person; notarized and apostilled corporate registers; corporate director passports; sanctions and PEP screening reports from a reputable compliance database; and a written explanation of economic substance for each holding entity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Lack of credible source-of-wealth evidence for the inbound equity contribution, which is high-risk for round-tripping or cash laundering.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board resolution and written equity contribution agreement; 12-month audited bank statements of the ultimate shareholder; audited parent financial statements; tax receipts for source funds; a notarized declaration that funds are not derived from criminal proceeds; SAFE foreign investment registration confirmation; and proof of external financing if debt-funded.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transaction profile inconsistent with the ISIC low-risk-standard classification because the EPC contract involves unverifiable third-party intermediaries or fronting billing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed original EPC contract with a complete schedule of works; municipal tender or procurement award notice; detailed bill of quantities; engineered process design documents; supplier contracts, invoices and shipping or customs records; progress payment certificates; independent technical valuation for reverse osmosis equipment; and a certified CPA capital verification report where the injection is used.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Positive sanctions or adverse-media hits on a municipal client, state-owned utility, or their controlling officials, creating corruption and PEP liability in a government-linked water project.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enhanced due diligence report on the municipal counterparty; ownership structure of the state-owned utility; PEP screening for legal representatives and procurement committee members; anti-bribery and anti-corruption certification executed by the off-taker; a project compliance audit trail including open tender minutes; contractual representation that no official holds a direct or indirect private interest; and a remedial action protocol if adverse media emerges.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound equity contributions must be routed via licensed banks in mainland China after obtaining SAFE foreign investment information registration for the WFOE. The overseas shareholder gives SWIFT MT103 instructions with a purpose code for direct investment as paid-in capital and must be named as the remitter. The bank will credit the capital account and, before converting to RMB, will review the resolution, articles of association, and the SAFE registration. After funds are received, a PRC CPA must issue a capital verification report; if a World Bank escrow is used, the project escrow proceeds should be kept distinct from the FDI registered capital, and withdrawals to the WFOE will follow the escrow agreement and SAFE cross-border escrow rules.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements for EPC procurement may be executed through direct SWIFT MT103 transfers for smaller service or equipment payments, import documentary letters of credit with a confirming bank for large machinery purchases, and documentary collections on either documents-against-payment or documents-against-acceptance terms where commercial risk is managed by both banks. Each payment requires a SAFE trade declaration using contract, commercial invoice, bill of lading or airway bill, insurance certificate, and customs declaration. For service-related outflows, tax clearance and service trade declaration are required. The WFOE should procure a dedicated foreign currency disbursement account at the same tier-1 bank to create a full audit trail.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable CNY FX forward contracts against USD or EUR for contracted import, export, and capital-reflow exposures, requiring underlying trade or financial documentation and settlement through a licensed PRC bank.
Onshore FX swaps and cross-currency interest-rate swaps for long-term project financing in foreign currency, subject to SAFE registration and demonstration of genuine hedged exposure.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are offshore instruments and are not generally permissible for a mainland WFOE to book directly; resident entities cannot hedge through offshore NDFs because SAFE requires onshore real delivery and proof of the underlying trade.

Structured options are permissible only where the underlying exposure is genuine and the product is sold by a licensed PRC bank as part of a demonstrable risk-management purpose; speculative derivative transactions are prohibited.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Information Publication Report (Annual Report on the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), via the local Municipal Market Supervision Administration, filed online through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 to June 30 each year, covering the immediately preceding calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: After June 30, the enterprise is automatically placed in the List of Enterprises Operating Abnormally within 10 working days; if the failure continues for 3 consecutive years, the enterprise is placed on the List of Seriously Illegal and Untrustworthy Enterprises, potentially leading to administrative revocation of the business license by SAMR; publication of false or concealed information attracts a fine of RMB 5,000 to RMB 30,000 (approx. USD 700 to USD 4,200) plus inclusion in the abnormal list.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Income Tax (EIT) Final Settlement Filing with audited financial statements attached
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA), local Municipal Tax Service
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within five months after the close of the calendar tax year, no later than May 31 of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers a fine of up to RMB 2,000 (approx. USD 280) for ordinary cases or RMB 10,000 (approx. USD 1,400) for serious cases; underpaid tax triggers a daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05% of the overdue amount plus an administrative penalty of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax; continued non-compliance enables tax authorities to freeze bank accounts, seize property, and restrict the legal representative from exiting China.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Foreign Investment Information Report (FDI Annual Report) including actual controller confirmation and audited financial indicators
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) and State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), submitted through the integrated National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 to June 30 each year; any change in shareholding or actual controller must additionally be reported to SAMR within 30 days of occurrence
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or false filing triggers a rectification order from MOFCOM; if not rectified within the prescribed time limit, a fine of RMB 100,000 to RMB 300,000 (approx. USD 14,000 to USD 42,000) may be imposed; the enterprise also enters the abnormal operations list and may face suspension of cross-border foreign exchange transactions by SAFE.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under Article 164 of the PRC Company Law, every company, including a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE), must prepare annual financial accounting reports and have them audited by a lawfully established Chinese CPA firm. No balance-sheet, turnover, or headcount quantitative threshold exempts a WFOE from mandatory audit; the obligation attaches purely to corporate registration. For applicable accounting-standard calibration, the 2017 National Economic Statistical Classification for construction and water infrastructure (ISIC 4220 / NAICS 237110) defines a medium or large enterprise if any of the following indicators are exceeded: (a) total assets above RMB 50 million (approx. USD 7 million), (b) annual operating turnover above RMB 50 million (approx. USD 7 million), or (c) average employees exceeding 300. Entities exceeding these indicators must prepare full PRC Enterprise Accounting Standards (CAS) financial statements; smaller WFOEs may apply the simplified Small Enterprise Accounting Standards (SEAS) but remain fully subject to the mandatory annual audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Enterprise Accounting Standards (CAS / Chinese GAAP) for all medium and large enterprises, substantially IFRS-converged; simplified PRC Small Enterprise Accounting Standards (SEAS) for qualifying small enterprises; no direct IFRS filing is authorised in China, but CAS differences from IFRS are closely reconciled for cross-border reporting purposes.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The PRC does not operate a public UBO registry. The WFOE must: (i) confirm its ultimate beneficial owner and actual controller in the annual Foreign Investment Information Report due no later than June 30 each year; (ii) report any change of actual controller, legal representative, or shareholder structure to SAMR within 30 days of the resolution or agreement; (iii) maintain and physically update the statutory registers at the registered office, including the register of members, register of directors, register of charges/mortgages, and the resolution minute book; (iv) apply PBOC Anti-Money Laundering Law requirements for identification and verification of beneficial owners of bank accounts and external financial stakeholders; (v) ensure that any share transfer is registered with SAMR within 30 days, with the annual report thereafter reflecting the new capital chain and beneficial ownership status.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Register of Charges/Mortgages, Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 800 to USD 3,000 per annum for a standard WFOE registered office address or corporate agent service in a Tier-2 or Tier-3 municipal area; USD 2,500 to USD 5,500 per annum in Beijing, Shanghai, or Shenzhen.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 to USD 8,000 for a medium-complexity WFOE EPC entity with annual turnover below USD 10 million; USD 8,000 to USD 20,000 for larger EPC contractors with turnover between USD 10 million and USD 50 million.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Qualifying municipal sewage treatment project income may enjoy a three-year exemption followed by a three-year 50% reduction under the Public Infrastructure Project Incentive Catalogue; a certified High and New Technology Enterprise may reduce the headline rate to 15%; a 100% additional deduction is available for qualifying R&D expenditures, effectively allowing a 200% deduction; certain regional free-trade zone or local incentive policies may further reduce the effective burden.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (A) - Form A100000 filed through the State Taxation Administration Electronic Tax Bureau (eTax) portal, together with required schedules for tax adjustments, related-party transactions, foreign tax credits, and incentive claims.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual reconciliation return with quarterly prepayments; quarterly CIT prepayment return is due 15 days after each quarter-end, and the annual reconciliation is due within 5 months after the fiscal year-end.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For a calendar-year WFOE, the annual return must be filed by May 15 of the following year; quarterly prepayments for Q1, Q2, Q3, and Q4 are due by April 15, July 15, October 15, and January 15 respectively.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating revenue from engineering, procurement, construction, design, installation, commissioning, and operation services of the municipal sewage treatment and reverse osmosis water treatment plant.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare all Chinese-source revenue in the WFOE return; no foreign-source revenue should be booked unless separately evidenced. Recognize design and EPC revenue over time based on percentage-of-completion supported by World Bank escrow drawdown statements, certified milestone certificates, and progress reports; avoid year-end artificial deferral through undisclosed offshore escrow arrangements.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating cost, including reverse osmosis membranes, chemicals, construction materials, subcontractor fees, labor, energy, and direct equipment procurement expenditures.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All subcontractor invoices must be genuine and VAT invoice-verified; related-party procurement from foreign suppliers must be at arm's length and contemporaneously documented. No undocumented cost should be deducted; erroneous booking of capital expenditures as operating costs will be adjusted with interest and potential penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selling, general and administrative expenses, financial expenses, impairment losses, fair-value changes, and investment income before operating profit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cross-border royalty and interest payments in this section must be separately disclosed and subjected to non-resident withholding tax. Related-party interest above the statutory thin-capitalization limit (2:1 debt-to-equity ratio for non-financial enterprises) is non-deductible; management fees should be justified by actual services, identifiable benefits, and arm's-length pricing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total accounting profit before income tax as reconciled to PRC GAAP financial statements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconciliation between financial reporting and tax reporting must be supported by a workpaper file. Municipal sewage treatment project income qualifying for the three-plus-three incentive must be separated from non-qualifying commercial income; the WFOE should maintain a project-by-project P&L ledger to avoid disqualification.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after add-backs, deductions, adjusted non-deductible expenses, and offsetting of prior-year tax losses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Add back non-deductible penalties, excessive entertainment expenses, non-arm's-length related-party charges, and disallowed interest; deduct qualifying R&D super deduction, incentive project income, and the statutory 5-year tax loss carryforward. For the WFOE, prior-year losses of the same entity can be carried forward 5 years; losses of a different project or subsidiary cannot be offset without structural compliance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable tax rate and tentative corporate income tax payable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use 25% as the default statutory rate unless the WFOE qualifies for the 15% High and New Technology Enterprise rate; calculate quarterly prepayments already remitted and reconcile the tentative annual liability. Any treaty-based foreign tax credit should only be claimed if genuine foreign-source income exists, which is exceptional for a China municipal sewage EPC operator.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax reductions, tax credits, foreign tax credit offsets, and final net tax payable or refundable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply only statutory environmental protection equipment credits and incentive-related reductions; offset withheld prepayments; pay any final balance due by the annual deadline. Overpayment can be refunded or carried forward, but an intentional underpayment creates criminal exposure. All entries must reconcile with the underlying bank receipts from SWIFT/wire payments and World Bank escrow accounts.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the annual or quarterly return attracts a penalty of up to RMB 2,000, or RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000 where the delay is serious; unpaid tax accrues a late-payment surcharge of 0.05% per day. Fraudulent underdeclaration under Article 63 of the Law on Administration of Tax Collection triggers a monetary fine of 50% to 5 times the underpaid tax, plus surcharge; where the underpayment is criminal, tax evasion under Criminal Law Article 201 can be prosecuted, exposing the company and responsible directors to fines and imprisonment.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on outbound dividends paid by the WFOE to a non-resident enterprise, unless an applicable China Double Tax Agreement provides a lower rate such as 5% for beneficial owners holding at least 25% of the equity capital.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Before distributing dividends, the WFOE must pass a board resolution, prepare a distribution statement, make a withholding declaration through the eTax portal, and remit the withholding tax within 7 days. To claim treaty relief, the non-resident shareholder must submit to the WFOE: (i) a Tax Residence Certificate issued by the home tax authority for the relevant year; (ii) a completed treaty benefit statement/application under SAT Announcement 2019 No. 35; (iii) a beneficial ownership declaration proving active business, employees, premises, substantive decision-making, and assumption of risk; (iv) shareholder register, shareholding percentage, and holding-period evidence; and (v) any Limitation on Benefits or Principal Purpose Test declaration required by the treaty. The WFOE may apply the reduced withholding rate before remittance if documentation is complete; otherwise the domestic 10% is withheld and the non-resident may file a refund claim within three years.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: The domestic statutory withholding rate for both interest and royalties paid to a non-resident enterprise is 10%. Under most Chinese DTAs the treaty rate for interest is capped at 7% to 10% and royalties at 5% to 10%, conditional on beneficial ownership and no treaty abuse. Cross-border interest must also satisfy the arm's-length standard and thin-capitalization rules; royalties for trademarks, patents, know-how, or process technology must be supported by a registration, technical service agreement, actual use in China, and an outbound payment certificate, with relevant VAT withholding handled separately.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: China imposes Local File requirements when annual related-party transactions exceed: RMB 200 million for tangible property transfers; RMB 100 million for intangible property transfers; RMB 100 million for financial asset transfers; and RMB 40 million for other related-party transactions. A Master File is required when aggregate related-party transactions reach RMB 1 billion in a financial year; a Country-by-Country report notification applies when the group consolidated revenue equals or exceeds RMB 5.5 billion.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: China does not apply an OECD-style Economic Substance Regulation, but the tax authorities rigorously enforce substance-over-form, beneficial ownership, and anti-treaty-abuse doctrines. For a WFOE engaged in municipal sewage treatment EPC, the Core Income-Generating Activities must be performed in China and include engineering design, procurement, project management, construction oversight, commissioning, financial control, and risk management. A pure pass-through or shell entity with no employees, premises, assets, or real decision-making cannot support treaty withholding reductions and will face recharacterization under the GAAR.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion through Fraudulent Cost Inflation and Revenue Suppression
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Creating false subcontractor arrangements, fabricating reverse-osmosis membrane purchases, using false or inflated VAT invoices for construction materials, diverting municipal sewage treatment project revenue into offshore accounts, or suppressing China-source escrow receipts in the WFOE accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Article 63 of the Law on Administration of Tax Collection imposes a penalty of 50% to 5 times the underpaid tax, together with daily late payment surcharge of 0.05%; false invoicing is separately punishable under the Tax Invoice Administration Measures; Criminal Law Article 201 criminalizes tax evasion, subjecting the enterprise to fines and responsible individuals to imprisonment for up to ten years for especially large fraudulent underpayments.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts and tax authorities will pierce the corporate veil where directors commingle personal and corporate assets, sign false contracts, or personally control the evasion scheme; directors and the de facto controlling person can be jointly and severally liable for the unpaid tax, penalties, interest, and restitution. Personal bank accounts may be frozen, travel bans and serious-tax-dishonesty blacklisting can be imposed, and criminal conviction for tax evasion carries personal imprisonment and confiscation of assets.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Treaty Shopping Abuse in Profit Repatriation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Establishing a Hong Kong, Singapore, or other foreign conduit with no employees, offices, business purpose, or economic risk solely to hold WFOE equity and receive dividends, interest, or royalties while falsely claiming beneficial ownership and reduced DTA withholding rates.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: EIT Law Article 47 and SAT Announcement 2019 No. 35 allow the tax authority to deny treaty benefits where beneficial ownership is absent; the statutory 10% withholding tax is reimposed and interest is charged. Intentional false statements to the tax authority trigger Article 63 of the Law on Administration of Tax Collection with a 50% to 5 times penalty; the General Anti-Avoidance Rule may also recharacterize the capital structure and deny future treaty relief.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false beneficial-ownership declarations or knowingly execute conduit agreements can be held personally liable for the shortfall in withholding tax, face civil restitution to the treasury, and be placed under exit restrictions and blacklisting if they obstruct collection. Criminal prosecution for tax fraud or tax evasion is available where the conduit arrangement was used to conceal the true owner, with personal imprisonment and disgorgement of any profits extracted through the shell.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Manipulation and Documentation Failure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying non-arm's-length prices for intercompany purchases of reverse-osmosis equipment and engineering services, allocating excessive margins to related foreign entities, failing to prepare contemporaneous Local File or Master File documentation, or failing to file the required related-party transaction schedules with the annual CIT return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: EIT Law Article 41 and SAT Announcement 2016 No. 42 permit the tax authority to make a transfer-pricing adjustment and reallocate profits based on economic substance; whereas failure to provide contemporaneous documentation and poor cooperation empower the tax authority to use a fallback method and adjust taxable income. If the adjustment results from fraud or gross negligence, Article 63 of the Law on Administration of Tax Collection imposes a 50% to 5 times penalty on the additional tax; excessive related-party interest is simultaneously disallowed under thin-capitalization rules.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A director, CFO, or de facto manager who knowingly executes non-arm's-length agreements and fabricates transfer-pricing files may be treated as personally involved in a corporate crime; under PRC unit-crime doctrine the company is fined and the responsible executive receives personal imprisonment. Tax authorities can pierce the veil and hold directors personally liable where corporate formalities have been abused, and serious cases lead to asset freezing, travel bans, blacklisting, and personal criminal liability for tax evasion.
